about_the_game:
Project Sync is a high-octane, sc-fi arena shooter that revitalizes the classic genre for a new generation. Set aboard the Mars-bound starship Aurora, players are thrust into a state-of-the-art combat simulation to prepare for the challenges ahead.

Pure, Skill-Based Combat This is a return to pure, competitive FPS action. Victory is determined by skill, not by loadouts or perks. Master lightning-fast movement, including double jumps and tactical slides, to outmaneuver your opponents. The balanced sandbox of powerful sci-fi weapons and game-changing power-ups ensures that every encounter is a fresh test of your reflexes and strategy.

Master Multiple Game Modes Dive into a variety of competitive modes designed for endless replayability:

  • Classic Deathmatch & Team Deathmatch: The ultimate test of raw aiming skill.

Play Your Way: Online & Offline Challenge players from around the world in our dedicated online multiplayer. Or, hone your skills offline against highly customizable AI bots. For a classic couch gaming experience, battle it out with friends in up to 4-player local split-screen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: none
  • Additional Notes: none

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

short_description: Experience a new generation of sci-fi arena FPS. Project Sync delivers pure, skill-based combat in fast-paced Martian arenas. Master tactical counter-play across multiple online modes, challenge intelligent AI bots offline, or battle friends in local split-screen. No loadouts, just pure skill.
